result.notes: Magento/Adobe Commerce is self-hosted (or Adobe-managed Cloud Service) ecommerce software, not a hosted SaaS API you sign up for centrally. Credentials (OAuth 1.0a integration tokens, admin/customer tokens, or IMS OAuth2 for Commerce as a Cloud Service) are generated by the store's own admin after installing/provisioning a Magento Open Source (free) or Adobe Commerce (licensed) instance — there's no vendor-hosted free dev sandbox to sign up for. Rated yellow-leaning via blocker=other because the practical entry barrier is standing up/owning a store instance, not credential gating itself. API surface is large: dozens of REST resource groups covering catalog, sales, customers, carts, inventory, etc., plus a full GraphQL storefront API. MCP support is community-only (a third-party "magento-cloud" server), no official Adobe-published MCP server found.
result.one_liner: Magento (Adobe Commerce) is a self-hosted/cloud ecommerce platform exposing REST and GraphQL APIs for catalog, sales, customer, and storefront operations.
